envelope.description: Add postComment to the tracker port and mark the attach comment

body.title: Add postComment to the tracker port and mark the attach comment
body.summary: Add TrackerPort.postComment(issue, body) answering { externalId } to src/workflow/tracker/port.ts, implement it in src/workflow/tracker/github-adapter.ts through ghPostCommentReturningId, give the attach comment the first-line marker <!-- insrc:attach:<artifact id> -->, and add postComment to the two other test fakes (src/workflow/__tests__/approve-fallback-kit.ts and src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/attach.test.ts).
acceptanceChecks: The GitHub adapter's postComment posts one comment and answers its id, and answers a failed PortResult when the post fails or returns no id
The attach comment starts with the marker line and still holds the Attached line and the link, so s6's reconciliation by link still finds it
Every TrackerPort fake in the repository typechecks with postComment

tests.name: port-post-comment.test.ts: the GitHub adapter's postComment answers the comment id and attach posts its marker
